# Normative System

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NormativeSystem`](gmeow-NormativeSystem.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NormativeSystem>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

A body of norms with a shared identity — a constitution, a legal code, a code of conduct, a principia document, a rubric set. Member norms attach via [`gmeow:partOf`](../properties/gmeow-partOf.md). A normative system is itself issued ([`gmeow:systemIssuer`](../properties/gmeow-systemIssuer.md)), and competing systems coexist without inconsistency: GMEOW records what each prescribes and never adjudicates between them (Principles 1, 9).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NormativeSystem`](gmeow-NormativeSystem.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:SocialObject`](gmeow-SocialObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
